verified.headline: Agreed to a three-year contract extension

facts.notes: The club article (March 11, 2025) says he 'agreed to an extension' of three years, 'expected to land a three-year contract worth up to $18 million'. Stored 'Signed ... $13.5 million with $5 million guaranteed' should become 'Agreed to'. $13.5M/$5M was not confirmed by any fetched source (it is likely the base value under the $18M maximum). The club also calls it the richest special-teams deal ever; leave that out. He was a pending RFA, not under contract for 2025, so 'Re-signed' is also defensible.
